strongest_angle: The Andhra Pradesh government has overhauled its fireworks safety framework following fatal manufacturing unit explosions in Rayavaram and Vetlapalem by introducing a system of centralized monitoring, risk-based inspections, and a two-stage licensing process.

key_facts.fact: The Andhra Pradesh government issued a government order on November 7, 2026, establishing new safety frameworks and committees following explosions at Sri Ganapathi Grand Fireworks in Rayavaram and Surya Sri Fire Works in Vetlapalem.

Under the new framework announced on November 7, 2026, the Director-General of State Disaster Response and Fire Services is placed in charge of fireworks safety, making inspecting officers personally accountable.

The reforms introduced in Andhra Pradesh following the Rayavaram and Vetlapalem blasts feature a state-wide online portal for issuing two-stage licences with geo-tagged proof and risk-based inspections.

named_entities.name: Director-General of State Disaster Response and Fire Services
